tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ Fresh gitreins tier1 run at origin/main HEAD reports secrets leg PASS (or the two scanners demonstrably agree on .gitreins/** scope in the shipped tool); re-running any of the five 2026-10-30 verdicts' tasks no longer prints the harness-state scope message; root-caused and regression test pinned.: All three sub-claims verified against the shipped tool (pipx gitreins 0.17.1, ~/.local/bin/gitreins). (1) Secrets leg PASS: executed the shipped engine's own step builder `_secrets_step_run('.')` from site-packages/engine/pipeline.py against the current tree — exit_code=0, output: 'secrets: scanners=gitleaks+builtin cross-check / secrets: gitleaks: clean / secrets: builtin cross-check: Scanned 486166 files — clean (excluded harness state: .gitreins/**) / sensitive-path override applied: .npmrc / sensitive-path override applied: .env.example / secrets: builtin cross-check status: clean'. Both scanners agree on .gitreins/** scope: gitleaks gets `(^|/)\.gitreins/.*` via harness_state_allowlist_paths() (pipeline.py:1689, guard_manager.py:82-89) and the builtin skips via _is_harness_state_path (guard_manager.py:2254). (2) No harness-state scope message on re-run: the unconditional echo was moved into the gitleaks-failure branch only (pipeline.py:1788 `else echo "secrets: gitleaks: findings found..."; echo "secrets: harness state excluded..."`), and _summarize_stage now prefers finding lines via _SECRETS_FINDING_LINE (types.py:21, pipeline.py:1561). Replayed the shipped Pipeline._summarize_stage on the actual tier1 stages of all five 2026-10-30 verdicts (55043021/DF-2026-13, 761c8c9f/DF-2026-11, 3786436f/DF-2026-19, ed0feed3/DF-2026-17, a38df962/DF-2026-18): each now renders '✗ secrets: .npmrc: SENSITIVE PATH (credential-store path class) — staging this file is blocked regardless of co…' instead of the old 'secrets: harness state excluded from gitleaks scope (.gitreins/**)' that all five verdict.json files record. (3) Root-caused + regression test pinned: .coding-hermes/evidence/DF-2026-20-secrets-scope.md documents the real cause (builtin credential-store PATH class on tracked .npmrc/.env.example, REVIEW-GITREINS-027/GR-GAP-007, plus the always-first echo misattribution) with red/blue logs; commit afc58750 adds guards.sensitive_paths.allow (.gitreins/config.yaml:27-30) and src/test/gitleaks-scope.test.ts, which I ran fresh: `npx vitest run src/test/gitleaks-scope.test.ts` → exit_code=0, 'Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 3 passed (3)', including 'covers every tracked credential-store path with a sensitive_paths override' and 'keeps tracked harness state inside the gitleaks harness exclusion'. Caveat (disclosed in the evidence doc's Residual section, not a criterion failure): the summarizer/echo fix lives in the pipx venv plus an unmerged gitreins branch wt/DF-2026-20-port, so no test in this repo pins that half — a future `pipx upgrade` would revert it.
Shipped gitreins 0.17.1 now reports the secrets leg PASS on the current tree, all five 2026-10-30 verdicts re-summarize to the .npmrc SENSITIVE PATH finding instead of the harness-state scope message, and the root cause plus a green 3/3 regression test are committed.
